translation: O when will Śrī Chaitanya bestow upon me His grace? When will I get shelter in the shade of the holy feet of the Vaiṣṇavas?
When will I give up the false ego of being an enjoyer and when will I offer all respects to the sincere devotees of Lord Viṣṇu?
When will I submit myself by the feet of the Vaiṣṇava with the cloth of surrender around my neck and with straw between my teeth?
Weeping and weeping when will I submit my sorrowful tale at the feet of the Vaiṣṇava, and when will I seek relief from the fire of material suffering praying to that Vaiṣṇava for shelter and rest?
Upon hearing the tale of my worldly sorrow, that saintly Vaiṣṇava will petition Kṛṣṇa on my behalf in prayer.

text: e hena pāmara prati habena sadaya
translation: Then satisfied by that Vaiṣṇava’s prayer, Kṛṣṇa will be merciful upon this wicked and sinful wretch.

text: kṛpā kari’ saṅge laha ei akiñchane
translation: Bhakti Vinod Ṭhākur submits this prayer at the lotus feet of the Vaiṣṇavas: “Give me your grace and accept this lowly soul in your association.”
